ModMetaData.name: Shipcracker Warcasket
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Shipcracker, a late-game boarding warcasket for Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates, welded at the warcasket foundry like any other set.
Its drop thrusters power the breach jump, which punches through roofs and walls on landing. With Odyssey, the same thrusters power the breach burn in space, with unlimited range to anywhere in line of sight.
Requires VFE Pirates. Odyssey is optional. Supports Combat Extended, Save Our Ship 2 and Vanilla Gravship Expanded.
